calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;

-- Verify the fiscal period and date range
SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.fiscal_year, 
    d.fiscal_period, 
    MIN(d.calendar_date) as period_start,
    MAX(d.calendar_date) as period_end,
    COUNT(*) as day_count
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period;
